provenance: Fixture data is invented and labeled illustrative; a measured source keeps the SOURCE REVIEW REQUIRED line. The provenance line is drawn inside the graphic.
licenses: Project MIT for the component; pinned Lucide 0.468.0 (ISC) icons and ECharts 6.0.0 (Apache-2.0) via the existing vendor manifest; no new third-party files.

checks: token-only colors and verified palette switch
no ellipsis, collision, occlusion or clipping

purpose: Show stage counts as shares of the first stage.
use_when: Pipelines where each stage is a subset of the previous one.
not_when: Stages that are not subsets, or when attributing the drop-off matters (that needs its own evidence).
limits: A zero stage is drawn as a dashed line; percentages are of the first stage only.
